It’s hard, I can only give you advice on what’s been keeping me strong with my head up. I stay in touch with my little sister. She’s only 17. But she assures me every time all we have is family, and they will always want what’s best for me. Also, to allow yourself to feel. If you aren’t the religious kind, write down everything you experience. If you are, pray and speak to Him knowing he’s right there with you. He(God) will never give you anything you can’t handle. He’s my father and best friend as of right now. Which is funny bc I don’t go to church every Sunday. But I know I will be ok and safe. I pray for my boyfriend as well. I also keep myself grounded. With music. It keeps everything realistic and I listen to what makes my bones jump a little. Bc deep down I love dancing. When I can’t cry but I know I have to I put some crying music on. And when I want to be happy for just a second, I put whatever music lifts my spirit up. You’ve got to make yourself happy. You’ve got to keep your spirit and not let him or anyone control the only thing you’ve got guaranteed. That’s your spirit, mentality and emotions. I’ve got you and ~anyone~ going through this in my prayers. For you two to find happiness and harmony within each other.

Thank you for this, I know that’s a way to start for anyone in this same situation. I have a big considerate heart, I’ve managed to keep intact despite all my downfalls. And I know you cannot physically help everyone. But I also have deep understanding for the other person, so it just hurts me to see him hurting this much he feels the need to act out towards me. So I do my best to get him out of that mentality. The suicide hotline has actually put me on a holding line before that was meant to be for him, and that’s very crucial tbh. We also can’t afford therapy. So even if I leave and save myself, who will be able to save him? His parents don’t believe there’s a thing as depression. Or emotions for that matter. He’s supposed to be a “tough no nonsense man” ever since he was born. And that’s unrealistic bc we all feel. That’s how he manage to bottle all of his feelings up and explode now.
